answer: A sybil-proof agent economy should charge a small refundable bond before an agent can trade, then let peers verify its work over time. Like a grove that grows only from planted seeds, reputation accrues slowly: each completed, attested job adds a crystal-clear record that cannot be faked in bulk. A fresh comet of identical accounts may flash brightly, but without bonded history and peer attestations it earns no trust and no rewards, so creating thousands of fake identities costs more than it can return.
